preamble: Retraction of the voiceless velar stop [k] to the uvular [q], typically before or after back vowels. In Kipchak Turkic, the back-vowel allophone of Proto-Turkic *k became a distinct uvular /q/ (Kazakh қара qara 'black'), and in Selkup, Proto-Samoyedic *k before back vowels regularly became q (*kålä 'fish' > Taz Selkup qe̮li̮), while it palatalized to š before front vowels.

examples.to: Kazakh қара qara, Bashkir ҡара qara
examples.note: Velar *k in back-vowel words is realized as uvular [q]; Kazakh and Bashkir spell it with a separate letter (қ, ҡ).
cf. Tundra Nenets χalʹa, Nganasan koli̮
cf. Tundra Nenets χoba; before front vowels *k instead became Selkup š.

sources: COPIUS (2021). Foundations of Uralic etymology: Samoyedic (version 1.4). Community of Practice in Uralic Studies. https://copius.univie.ac.at/etymology/slides_13_samo.pdf
